Exploring practical applications of technology through web tools, games, and virtual environments.

Master’s thesis · Web application

Making Thinking Visible: AI Mathematics Companion ↗

A mathematics problem-solving system combining an interactive canvas and multiple AI agents. Students express their reasoning through handwriting, drawings, and text; the system analyzes the canvas and recent dialogue to adapt guidance to an estimated problem-solving stage.

My contribution: Independently built the interactive canvas, PHP / MySQL backend, AI-agent coordination, prompt strategies, and feature integration. Study questionnaires and scales drew on instruments used by senior research-group members and prior literature.

  • JavaScript
  • Fabric.js
  • PHP
  • MySQL
  • Multimodal AI
  • Multi-agent

University project · TAECT 2022 fourth place

BioUtopia · Dreaming about Health and Biology ↗

A first-person RPG that maps human organs to familiar places. Storytelling, cell characters, and four types of game challenges bring together Grade 7 biology and health education. It received fourth place at TAECT 2022 and was presented at TWELF 2023.

My contribution: Built many Unity scenes and wrote C# code. Prepared curriculum content, questions, and digital education research with teammates to complete the game.

  • Unity
  • C#
  • Educational RPG
  • Analogy-based learning
  • Biology / Health education

NSTC research project · Unity / VRChat SDK development

Advancing metaverse education: Exploring new possibilities of immersive VR-based collaborative learning ↗

An immersive learning environment built with Unity and the VRChat SDK to support multi-user interaction around junior-high STEM and the SDGs. An island scene for climate action lets students explore sea-level rise and discuss their ideas within the environment.

My contribution: Led the Unity / VRChat SDK environment development with one collaborator, discussing requirements, dividing tasks, and integrating the work into usable virtual learning scenes.

  • Unity
  • VRChat SDK
  • Meta Quest 2
  • Collaborative learning
  • STEM
  • SDGs

Deep learning competition · 37th of 151 on the private leaderboard

AI CUP 2022 crop image classification ↗

Used Python and PyTorch in the spring AI CUP 2022 crop image classification competition. The team scored 0.9838242 on the private leaderboard, ranking 37th of 151 teams in the top quarter.

My contribution: Primarily understood and integrated the training workflow, handling training-data input, model construction, evaluation, and test-result output. Teammates jointly curated the dataset and provided prepared data and training hardware.

  • Python
  • PyTorch
  • InceptionV3
  • EfficientNet
  • XGBoost
  • Transfer learning
  • Image classification
